strings.name: Sarah Sjöström
strings.role: Swimmer · Sprint freestyle and butterfly champion
strings.summary: Sjöström emerged in butterfly as a teenager before extending her world-class speed to freestyle and setting multiple world records. She won Sweden's first women's Olympic swimming gold in 2016 and both the 50 m and 100 m freestyle in 2024. Returning from maternity leave in 2026, she won European 50 m butterfly gold and 50 m freestyle silver in Paris, continuing her long championship career.

strings.timeline.t6.title: Butterfly record breakthrough
strings.timeline.t6.text: Swam 24.43 in the 50 m butterfly at Sweden's nationals for a world record.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First world title
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won the 100 m butterfly in Rome with a world record.
strings.timeline.t8.title: European championship breakthrough
strings.timeline.t8.text: Won European 100 m butterfly gold at fourteen, reaching the international elite.
